description: Fix 6 bugs found in code review of live-deployment-audit.sh: check_critical double-counting, JSON escaping, grep portability, temp file cleanup, CORS test logic, concurrent dir leaks
steps: Fix check_critical double-counting: remove TOTAL_FAIL and SECTION_FAIL increments so critical and fail counts are separate
Fix add_json_result: add proper JSON escaping for backslashes, tabs, control chars; replace silent fallback with stderr warning
Fix body_contains: use grep -E (extended regex) instead of grep BRE with GNU \| extension; convert all \| patterns to ERE |
Fix temp file leaks: add AUDIT_TMPDIR with trap on EXIT/INT/TERM; use AUDIT_TMPDIR for perform_request temp files
Fix CORS test logic gap: check for 405 status before asserting origin rejection
Fix concurrent test dirs: use AUDIT_TMPDIR subdirectories instead of standalone mktemp -d
acceptance_criteria: FAIL and CRITICAL counts are independent in summary
No \| patterns remain in body_contains calls or grep calls without -E
All temp files go into AUDIT_TMPDIR which is cleaned on exit/interrupt
CORS test reports inconclusive when endpoint returns 405
findings: All 6 fixes applied successfully. The --quick run shows Failed: 1 and Critical: 2 as separate counts (previously would have shown Failed: 3). The trap cleanup works correctly (no audit temp dirs persist). All 53 body_contains and 14 inline grep calls converted from BRE \| to ERE |.
